major_events: In 第1393章 华天都再现, Hua Tiandu suddenly appears at the top (rank 1) of the Heavenly Monarch candidate list, causing a massive shock across the Heavenly Court. The Heavenly Monarchs begin searching for him, and a reward is offered.
In 第1395章 追踪华天都 and 第1397章 驼神古界, Fang Han tracks Hua Tiandu to the Tuoshen Ancient World, seeking to secure the key to the Dan World before Hua Tiandu can.
In 第1398章 丹界钥匙的争夺 and 第1401章 又被夺取, Fang Han defeats Hua Tiandu's allies, capturing the Dan World key (the Moment Key / 刹那之匙) and the bloodstains of the Creation Immortal King from Hua Tiandu.
In 第1403章 天君的报复 and 第1404章 战皇甫彼岸, High-level Heavenly Monarchs like Huangfu Bi'an launch a retaliatory ambush on Fang Han. Fang Han engages in fierce combat with Huangfu Bi'an.
In 第1408章 鸿蒙殿中, Fang Han reunites with his ally Yuhuang and enters the Hongmeng Hall, where they study ancient formations to prepare for Fang Han's breakthrough.
In 第1413章 前往丹界（上） and 第1415章 造化神丹, Fang Han, Linglong, and Yuhuang travel to the Dan World and locate the ancient Fortune Divine Pill.
In 第1416章 无妄天君 and 第1417章 拼命抵挡, Lifeless Heavenly Monarch and Miao Di Heavenly Monarch arrive to disrupt Fang Han's breakthrough. Linglong and Yuhuang hold the line.
In 第1420章 晋升天君, Fang Han undergoes the tribulation of the Heavenly Monarch, surviving the cosmic tribulation to officially step into the Heavenly Monarch realm.
In 第1422章 夺取神棺 and 第1423章 斩杀天君（上）, Fang Han displays invincible power as a newly advanced Heavenly Monarch, reclaiming the Casket of Heaven and killing the Lifeless Heavenly Monarch.
In 第1426章 炼化四天君, Fang Han refines four enemy Heavenly Monarchs (including Lifeless Heavenly Monarch, Miao Di Heavenly Monarch, etc.) into his own body to increase his cultivation level.
In 第1428章 衣冠冢 and 第1429章 刹那王袍, they explore the tomb of the Dan World Master, finding his clothing and crown. Fang Han refuses to kneel but takes the Moment King Robe and other treasures.

In 第1433章 起源皇城 and 第1438章 起源王朝的天君, Fang Han enters the capital of the Origin Dynasty, dealing with Yuhuangye, and confronts the Dynasty's Heavenly Monarchs like Fusheng Heavenly Monarch and Hetu Heavenly Monarch.
In 第1440章 再炼万恶之源 and 第1441章 十一巫字, Fang Han refines the Source of All Evil and integrates the 11 ancient Witch characters, increasing his cultivation by an entire epoch.
In 第1443章 贪狼之主, Fang Han encounters the residual consciousness of the Master of Hungry Wolf in the Origin Land and defeats him.

In 第1453章 释迦天君，再临！, Fang Han fights the Origin Dynasty's forces. He defeats and absorbs Hetu Heavenly Monarch, upgrading his Eight Division Pagoda to a Saint-grade immortal weapon, while the reincarnated Shakya Heavenly Monarch's role is highlighted.
In 第1503章 始祖圣王, Fang Han battles the seven great Divine Emperors of the God Realm and the shadow of the Ancestral Holy King, successfully absorbing the Zhuxian Gate.

In 第1523章 镜世界, Fang Han is trapped in the Mirror World by the Heavenly Instrument Mother Sect led by Ronghua Lord, but he uses their attacks to dissolve the Heavenly Lord Divine Clothes and refine the Supreme Gate.
In 第1533章 降魔, Fang Han and Feng Baiyu travel to the Devil Realm to confront the various demon lords and negotiate at the Yuanshi Devil Mountain.
In 第1583章 华天都拜师, Hua Tiandu arrives at Qiankun City and becomes an apprentice to the Master of Qiankun to seek a way to defeat Fang Han.
In 第1603章 乾坤之死, Hua Tiandu betrays and kills his teacher, the Master of Qiankun, refining him to reach 15 epochs of cultivation with the help of the three Fairy Kings.

In 第1708章 阎的出现, Yan, the dragon spirit of the Yellow Spring Map who went missing after being sent to Taiyi Sect as a spy, reappears in the Fairy King Battlefield alongside the Yellow Spring Emperor's corpse, and is saved by Fang Han from Hua Tiandu.

In 第1623章 喷射神物, the Great Destruction of the cosmos begins. The non-Heavenly Monarch disciples of the Tiandu Sect suffer from the five signs of decay, while Hua Tiandu shows cruel indifference as they await the Gate of Eternity to spray sacred objects.
character_state_transitions: Fang Han transitions from a Half-step Heavenly Monarch to a true Heavenly Monarch by surviving the Heavenly Monarch Tribulation in 第1420章 晋升天君.
Fang Han transitions from a newly advanced Heavenly Monarch to an invincible powerhouse capable of killing and refining multiple Heavenly Monarchs simultaneously in 第1423章 斩杀天君（上） and 第1426章 炼化四天君.

Yuhuang transitions from a high-level Heavenly Lord to recovering his past identity and memories as the Zhongcai Lord and strengthening his cultivation, later wearing the Moment King Robe to survive deep abyss exploration in 第1483章 圣品无天.
Feng Baiyu transitions from a mortal cultivator to gradually awakening his ancient memories and powers as the reincarnated Shakya King Buddha in 第1443章 贪狼之主 and 第1453章 释迦天君，再临！.
Feng Yaoguang transitions her cultivation state by refining all the techniques of the Undefeated Heavenly Lord in 第1443章 贪狼之主.
Hua Tiandu transitions from a defeated candidate to receiving the support of the three Fairy Kings, finding the Three Lifetimes Stone, and apprenticing to the Master of Qiankun in 第1583章 华天都拜师.
Hua Tiandu transitions from an apprentice to a betrayer, killing and devouring his master, the Master of Qiankun, to reach 15 epochs of cultivation in 第1603章 乾坤之死.
Yan transitions from a missing spy to a Heavenly Monarch with 10 epochs of cultivation, residing in the Fairy King Battlefield alongside the Yellow Spring Emperor's corpse in 第1708章 阎的出现.
Hetu Heavenly Monarch transitions from a living Heavenly Monarch of the Origin Dynasty to being slain, torn in half, and refined by Fang Han in 第1453章 释迦天君，再临！.
Lifeless Heavenly Monarch transitions from a pursuing enemy Heavenly Monarch to being killed and refined by Fang Han during the Dan World breakthrough in 第1426章 炼化四天君.
The Eight Division Pagoda transitions from a normal immortal tool to a Saint-grade immortal weapon after absorbing the essence of the slain Futian and Hetu Heavenly Monarchs in 第1453章 释迦天君，再临！.
The Supreme Gate transitions to its near-complete form after Fang Han dissolves the Heavenly Lord Divine Clothes in 第1523章 镜世界.

long_form_mechanisms.name: Heavenly Monarch Tribulation (天君大劫)
long_form_mechanisms.description: A cosmic test involving extreme elemental and space-time tribulations (such as five-element ancient characters, heavenly tribulation thunder, etc.). Successfully surviving it allows a cultivator to break the shackles of the heavens and become a Heavenly Monarch, making them immune to the standard five signs of decay (天人五衰) during cosmic destruction. Cited in 第1420章 晋升天君.

long_form_mechanisms.name: The Casket of Heaven / Heaven Burial Casket (天葬之棺)
long_form_mechanisms.description: A supreme treasure of the Creation Immortal King, which can contain and refine Heavenly Monarchs and absorb cosmic energy. It is fought over by Fang Han and Hua Tiandu. Cited in 第1422章 夺取神棺.

long_form_mechanisms.name: The Moment Key / Dan World Key (刹那之匙)
long_form_mechanisms.description: A specialized key created using the blood of the Creation Immortal King and the legacy of the Dan World Master. It allows the holder to unlock the gates of the ancient Dan World, draw its massive medicinal/spiritual energy, and suppress opponents using the Dan World's laws. Cited in 第1398章 丹界钥匙的争夺.

long_form_mechanisms.name: Slain Heavenly Monarch Refining (炼化天君)
long_form_mechanisms.description: A process where a Heavenly Monarch is killed, and their body, soul, and laws are absorbed into the Epoch Divine Array of Fang Han, bypassing normal cultivation limits and directly increasing the user's epoch cultivation level. Cited in 第1426章 炼化四天君.

long_form_mechanisms.name: The 11 Ancient Witch Characters (十一巫字)
long_form_mechanisms.description: Pre-historical characters from the Gate of Eternity that contain the core laws of the Witch World. When refined (along with the Source of All Evil), they allow a cultivator to directly gain one epoch of cultivation. Cited in 第1441章 十一巫字.

long_form_mechanisms.name: The Mirror World Reflection (镜世界反射)
long_form_mechanisms.description: An array created by the Heavenly Instrument Mother Sect using the refined remains of the Mirror World. It traps targets and reflects all physical and magical attacks, doubling them back onto the target. Cited in 第1523章 镜世界.

long_form_mechanisms.name: The Epoch Divine Array / Jingti Shenguo (纪元神阵与晶体神国)
long_form_mechanisms.description: Fang Han's unique body structure consisting of countless microscopic crystal divine kingdoms. Each kingdom acts as an independent world that can replicate, analyze, and reflect hostile attacks, and store refined treasures and ancient characters. Cited in 第1503章 始祖圣王.

long_form_mechanisms.name: The Thirty-Three Heavenly Treasures (三十三天至宝)
long_form_mechanisms.description: A set of 33 treasures created by the Creation Immortal King, corresponding to 33 ancient characters from the Gate of Eternity. When refined with specialized materials (like the Casket of Heaven, Heavenly Lord Divine Clothes, and corresponding characters), they can transform into Saint-grade immortal weapons or even Creation Artifacts (造化神器). Cited in 第1483章 圣品无天.

long_form_mechanisms.name: The Three Lifetimes Stone (三生石)
long_form_mechanisms.description: The supreme treasure of the Yuanshi Devil Master, containing the power of the past, present, and future. It can dissolve and absorb anything, including high-level Heavenly Monarchs, and is used by Hua Tiandu to devour his master and increase his power. Cited in 第1583章 华天都拜师 and 第1603章 乾坤之死.

long_form_mechanisms.name: The Five Signs of Decay (天人五衰)
long_form_mechanisms.description: A cosmic degradation process that occurs during the Great Destruction of the universe, causing all non-Heavenly Monarch creatures to age, lose their magic power, and die. Cited in 第1623章 喷射神物.

continuity_observations: Hua Tiandu's power source depends on his past life's remains and treasures in early chapters. This is maintained as he later finds the Casket of Heaven, the Heavenly Lord Divine Clothes, and eventually seeks out the Master of Qiankun and the Three Lifetimes Stone to keep pace with Fang Han. Cited in 第1393章 华天都再现 and 第1583章 华天都拜师.

Feng Baiyu's status as the reincarnation of the Shakya King Buddha is teased earlier and develops dynamically as he begins to recover his memories and powers in the Origin Land and Devil Realm. Cited in 第1443章 贪狼之主 and 第1453章 释迦天君，再临！.

In 第1708章 阎的出现, the text explicitly recalls that Fang Han sent Yan to infiltrate the Taiyi Sect (太一门) as a spy. His long absence is resolved when he is found in the Fairy King Battlefield, having reached the Heavenly Monarch stage. Cited in 第1708章 阎的出现.

The requirement of finding the 33 ancient characters to fully upgrade the Thirty-Three Heavenly Treasures is introduced in 第1483章 圣品无天 and developed in 第1523章 镜世界 where Ronghua Lord writes them out in battle.

The Casket of Heaven is initially lost, disputed in the Tuoshen Ancient World, captured by Fang Han, and remains a central focal point of power struggle between Fang Han and Hua Tiandu. Cited in 第1398章 丹界钥匙的争夺 and 第1422章 夺取神棺.

Fang Han's past connections with the demon lords (like Chirenwang, Chiyuan, and Xinmo) are recalled when he goes to the Yuanshi Devil Mountain in the Devil Realm to establish an alliance. Cited in 第1533章 降魔.

The bloodstains of the Creation Immortal King are acquired in 第1398-1402章, which directly enables Fang Han to refine high-level keys and break through to the Heavenly Monarch level with higher probability. Cited in 第1398章 丹界钥匙的争夺.

The concept of 天人五衰 is introduced as an impending doom that drives all characters to scramble for resources, culminating in the actual onset of the Great Destruction in 第1623章 喷射神物 where low-level disciples begin to die. Cited in 第1623章 喷射神物.

The sudden jump in chapter numbering from 第1607章 to 第1708章, then returning to 第1609章, is a clear textual inconsistency. The story continues seamlessly despite the numerical jump, with the character Yan appearing in both 第1708章 (numerically out of order) and the subsequent chapters. Cited in 第1708章 阎的出现.
style_observations: The narrative measures cultivation progression in terms of 'epochs' (纪元) of power. Each major breakthrough or refinement adds a specific number of epochs, turning abstract cultivation into a quantifiable metric.

Battles follow a recurring pattern where Fang Han is surrounded by multiple hostile Heavenly Monarchs, absorbs their combined attacks using his crystal divine kingdoms, dissolves their treasures, and then refines them one by one while his enemies scream in disbelief.

Characters speak with extreme arrogance and defiance, frequently using phrases like '谁来都杀' (kill whoever comes), '跪下' (kneel down), and declaring their invincibility, which emphasizes the genre's power-fantasy aesthetics.
The text uses massive spatial scales to describe actions, such as 'tens of billions of miles of true qi' or 'hands as large as continents,' creating a hyperbolic sense of scale.
The cultivation realms, techniques, and characters draw heavily on Buddhist and Daoist terminology (e.g., Shakya King Buddha, five-element ancient characters, reincarnation, karma, etc.).
The plot is heavily driven by the acquisition of specific physical items (treasures, ancient characters, blood, pills), making cultivation feel like a series of material collection quests.

creation_family_evidence.serialization_hallmarks: The text shows hallmarks of rapid daily web novel serialization typical of early-2010s Chinese web portals (such as Qidian and Zhongheng). These include a structured layout of multi-part chapters (e.g. （上） and （下） designations in titles like 第1413章 前往丹界（上） and 第1414章 前往丹界（下）) designed to maintain daily update pacing and word count requirements.
creation_family_evidence.editorial_inconsistency: A major numbering jump occurs between Chapter 1607 (第1607章 黄泉大帝尸体) and Chapter 1609 (第1609章 再度交锋), where the intervening chapter is erroneously labeled 第1708章 阎的出现 (a typo of 1608). Despite the numerical label jumping forward by 100 chapters, the narrative flow is completely uninterrupted, with the character Yan being saved by Fang Han and the plot progressing directly into Chapter 1609, indicating a lack of post-publication editorial review.
creation_family_evidence.formulaic_power_quantification: The novel utilizes a heavily quantized cultivation progression system where power is measured in discrete 'epochs' (纪元) of cultivation (e.g., Hua Tiandu reaching exactly 15 epochs in 第1603章 乾坤之死). This arithmetical representation of power levels is a defining trait of late-stage web novel power scaling, designed to provide clear markers of progress for a long-serialized audience.
creation_family_evidence.quest_driven_structuring: The plot progresses through a series of resource-gathering quests in distinct cosmic zones (Dan World, Origin Dynasty, God Realm, Devil Realm, Qiankun City), with each zone providing specific items (such as the Fortune Divine Pill in 第1415章 造化神丹 or the 11 Witch characters in 第1441章 十一巫字) that act as immediate catalysts for power upgrades, mirroring the progression loops of video games.

originality_risks: The pattern of Fang Han entering a new realm, being ambushed by local elites, easily defeating and refining them, and then upgrading his treasures is highly formulaic and mirrors other xianxia novels, presenting a risk of repetitive plotting. Cited in 第1426章 炼化四天君 and 第1503章 始祖圣王.

Hua Tiandu is repeatedly defeated, loses all his treasures, but always manages to survive, find a new master, and get a massive power upgrade off-screen (like devouring his master the Master of Qiankun). This is a highly clichéd antagonist trope that risks feeling artificial. Cited in 第1583章 华天都拜师 and 第1603章 乾坤之死.

Measuring characters' power solely by 'epochs of cultivation' (e.g., 10 epochs, 12 epochs, 15 epochs) oversimplifies character dynamics and combat, turning battles into simple arithmetic comparisons which is a common trope in late-stage xianxia web novels. Cited in 第1603章 乾坤之死 and 第1623章 喷射神物.

Fang Han repeatedly breaks through bottlenecks or dissolves high-level artifacts (like the Heavenly Lord Divine Clothes) instantly by simply standing still and letting his enemies attack him, which trivializes the struggle of cultivation and relies on convenient plot armor. Cited in 第1523章 镜世界.
